INC-94  Back-to-back berth bookings are rejected
status: open   priority: P2   area: berths   reported: 2026-08-18 by berth-planning

Planners cannot book a vessel onto a berth at the exact time the previous vessel leaves
it. A booking that ends at noon and the next one starting at noon do not overlap, but
the schedule reports a clash.

Acceptance:
  The book method of BerthSchedule accepts a booking that starts exactly when another
  booking on the same berth ends (and one that ends exactly when another starts); bookings
  that genuinely overlap on the same berth are still refused.

Files:
  src/berths/schedule.ts

content.text: All 28 tests pass, including the new back-to-back booking cases. Let me check git status before wrapping up.

The user hasn't asked me to commit, so I'll stop here and let them decide.

Fixed INC-94: the `overlaps` check in `src/berths/schedule.ts:4` used `<=` on both boundaries, so touching bookings (one ending exactly when the next starts) counted as a clash. Changed to strict `<` so adjacent bookings are allowed while genuine overlaps are still refused. Added two tests covering both acceptance cases; full suite (28 tests) passes. Changes are unstaged — let me know if you'd like me to commit.
